inputs.text: SSANU’s one-month ultimatum over the 2009 agreement shows how students and families are too often caught in the crossfire when unions and government fail to resolve their disputes. The government should honor its obligations, but it must also protect the authority of schools and refuse to let threats of an indefinite nationwide strike dictate terms. Education is a public trust, not a bargaining chip; union leaders and officials alike should put students’ futures and the stability families depend on ahead of political pressure.
